name: Fukushuu no Ori ~OL Kankin Ryoujoku no Yakata~
original_name: 復讐の澱 ～OL監禁陵辱の館～
source:
Main character is a trading company employee. He accumulates great stress at work due to harassment of his female boss and pranks of female colleagues. These people are two-faced persons who worship money. One day protagonist wins in a lottery and swears revenge on these women.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是商社职员。由于女老板的骚扰和女同事的恶作剧，他在工作中积累了巨大的压力。这些人都是两面拜金的人。有一天，主角中了彩票，发誓要向这些女人报仇。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
